comparison.objective: Rotate tires in a cross pattern; candidate adjusts and validates a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Wheel removal, transport, alignment, mounting, and likely repeated fastening versus small hex-tool alignment, collar metering, counterholding, and cycle-based tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Tires occupy the prescribed crossed positions and are reinstalled versus two safe repeatable stops with no drift. Record supplies no body or specs.
comparison.reason: Even if fastening is involved, wheel exchange and pattern compliance test a different objective and outcome.
